style_when: the story is regulatory or contractual — a filing, a mandate, a rate notice, a certificate, a purchase order that changed the economics
prompt: Top-down 90-degree flat-lay photograph on a painted timber kitchen table: an open mortgage closing folder holding a single blank amortization schedule page, a sharpened red pencil lying across it, two small brass paper clips set at different depths along the page, and a brass house key resting beside the folder. Soft window light from the left rakes across the paper grain and casts long contact shadows; palette of bone white, graphite and ochre on matte paper and warm oak. 35mm lens, shallow depth of field at the page edge, asymmetric composition with the folder off-centre, generous negative space, no logos.
negative_prompt: garbled lettering, random words, watermarks, readable print, logos
rationale: The story is a regulatory and contractual trap: the PMI end dates live in the original loan paperwork, not in the homeowner's current equity statement. A document flat-lay makes the closing file and amortization schedule the hero, and the split-screen makes the request-vs-automatic contrast immediate.
cue: Your PMI Ends at 78%: Not Your Equity
subject: an open mortgage closing folder holding a blank amortization schedule page, a red pencil, two brass paper clips and a house key on a kitchen table
core_thesis: Private mortgage insurance ends on dates set in federal law and computed from the loan a household signed—a request at 80 percent of the original price, an automatic stop at 78 percent read off the original schedule, and a 180-month backstop—so extra principal buys the request date and never the automatic one.
core_conflict: homeowner's faster equity build versus the fixed 78% automatic cancellation date locked to the original loan schedule
composition: asymmetric top-down, the folder off-centre and low in frame, generous negative space
alt_text: An open grey closing folder on a kitchen table with a blank schedule page, a red pencil, brass clips and a house key.
caption: PMI Ends At 78% Not Your Equity: The 78% stop is read off the schedule; extra principal only buys the request date.
title: PMI Ends At 78% Not Your Equity
